data.name: Musaad
data.gender_notes: Musaad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musaad is a name that signifies a person who supports and promotes good deeds and noble causes. It is a name that reflects a strong sense of justice and morality. The name Musaad carries the meaning “Supporter of Good” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musaad usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter of good and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Musaad is associated with the concept of 'birr', which means righteousness and piety.
data.etymology: Musaad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter of Good.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musaad total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
